persons.name: Madanabhadra
persons.evidence: pustaka ma〈〈ḍa〉〉dnabhadrasya; śrīmancāvihāre śākyabhikṣuśrīmadanabhadrena svayaṃ pāṭhārthahetunā

purpose: for the owner Madanabhadra's own study/reading (svayaṃ pāṭhārthahetunā)
notes: The owner's name first appears corrupted as "ma〈〈ḍa〉〉dnabhadrasya", but the later "śrīmadanabhadrena" settles the reading as Madanabhadra. The catalogue lists him as donor; in the colophon he is the owner and commissioner, writing for his own reading, not a donor. Cāvihāra is probably Cā(ru)vihāra / Cābahil in the Kathmandu Valley, but this identification isn't certain, so "normalized" is left empty. The nakṣatra "viśāṣapraarādhana" is corrupt; Viśākhā is most likely. "vaiḥ" after rāmadattena is unclear. Kṛṣṇa aṣṭamī is assumed to fall in the CE year 1418 (Māgha falls in January–February).
